I am updating my review as I felt cheated. On the owners recommendations I made the purchase which was on a expensive side (around ₹10K plus). The lens used for my specs were from Essilor or Carl Zeis don’t remember exactly. When the specs arrived I was not happy with the result of my distance and reading vision, the images used to get kind of distorted especially when I used to move my head side ways while reading. The owner was kind enough to redo my lens and it was redone twice with no change in the results. When I queried the owner that she had used branded lens how can it give such bad results ??? She did not give me convincing answer. She didn’t even have proof proof of authenticity that branded lens were used. Since the specs were not meeting my requirements I politely asked for a refund to which she politely refused. Well that was the end of it, decided not to visit the shop again.
I feel I have been taken on a ride. The workmanship was poor and the quality of lens used was poor - I could figure out that only these two reasons I could think of.
I got my specs made in my hometown with less than half the money she charged me and they are really good and I am very happy.

I had a very positive experience at Naigaon Lotus Hospital. From the moment I entered, the staff was attentive, polite, and extremely professional. The hospital is clean, well-maintained, and has a calm environment that makes patients feel at ease.

The doctors are knowledgeable, compassionate, and take the time to explain the diagnosis and treatment options in a clear and reassuring manner. The nursing staff is equally supportive, always available, and genuinely caring toward patients and their families.

featured_reviews.name: zoya mulla
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience at Vatsal Eye Hospital was one of the worst medical experiences I’ve had.
Dr. Pritam Dedhia was shockingly disrespectful, dismissive, and completely lacking in empathy. There was no basic courtesy, no reassurance, and absolutely no sensitivity toward a patient clearly in discomfort.
During the eye examination, I was forced to keep my eye open under an extremely harsh light for an extended duration without blinking. A nurse held my head tightly from behind to stop me from moving, which felt aggressive and unnecessary. I repeatedly expressed that I was in pain and struggling, yet the procedure continued without pause.
My eyes were watering so intensely that my clothes were wet and still, there was no concern shown.
This is not how patients should be treated. No Skill no empathy.
I would strongly advise others to think twice before visiting.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
I'm sorry to hear that your experience at Vatsal Eye Hospital was so distressing. I want to assure you that our intention is always to provide quality care and respect to all patients.
Dr. Dedhia is an experienced ophthalmologist, and I'm sure the examination was conducted with the aim of getting an accurate diagnosis. The slit lamp examination can be uncomfortable, especially with bright light, but it's a crucial part of the eye exam. For the multiple complaints that you had, getting to accurate diagnosis was our priority. Everyday all our 50/60 OPD patients undergo the same routine slit lamp examination without which it is difficult for us to give you accurate treatment.
